reviewed_by: Claude review of two chat regressions from #456 and #460
reason: Two chat tests have been failing on main because of my own earlier changes, unseen because each of those receipts selected only its own Playwright area. #460 rendered Continue as mission first in the conversation actions menu as a hidden item for non-harness conversations; opening the menu focused that hidden button and arrow keys counted it, so 'conversation More actions remain usable on mobile Workbench navigation' failed. The item is now rendered only for harness conversations, after Export transcript so the first item is the same in every conversation, and first focus and arrow order skip hidden or disabled items; a disabled mission item explains why. #456 replaced the 'Retry final answer' error with a calm 'Finish the answer' status that deliberately has no Reload conversation button, and 'assistant upgrade names a provider turn that thinks without answering' still looked for the old controls; it now asserts the status the operator sees and completes the turn with Finish the answer. The conversation-details test for the mission item now also proves the keyboard order. The selection is the whole assistant area on its three mock projects, the area both regressions escaped, where it passed locally in full (desktop 51, mobile Chromium 44, mobile WebKit 47, none failing), plus conversation-details for the narrow sheet.
exclusions: Full Python, frontend and Playwright suites are excluded. No Python test is selected because no Python changed. No frontend unit test is selected: the only source change is the menu markup and its focus selectors in SessionsPage, which no unit test renders, and the Playwright journeys exercise them in a browser. No native tests are selected because no Rust changed. The assistant area's real-Core entry (assistant-real-desktop) is not selected: neither the menu nor the recovery notice changes anything Core serves, and the mock entries cover both in a browser. The provider-thinking test also fails on the narrow 390px desktop-Chrome project, where something covers the Thinking summary; that project is not in its area, it passes on the real phone projects, and it is outside this repair.
